aboutText: At Tedesco Electrics Pty Ltd, we are a team of police-checked professionals serving Airport West and the greater Melbourne area. Our expertise spans complete electrical services, advanced C-Bus programming, and cutting-edge security installations like CCTV and vape detection. We are dedicated to delivering safe, efficient, and tailored solutions for all your electrical and security needs.
